report: Orbital biopsy showed polarizable foreign-body material with negative cultures, directly supporting exogenous granulomatous inflammation and excluding infection/malignancy. MRI hypointense mass is consistent. Positive ANA, low C4, elevated ACE, saddle nose are nonspecific and likely secondary, not primary autoimmune disease. Though no trauma/injection/exposure source was identified, biopsy findings are diagnostic. Thus foreign-body granulomatous reaction is the unifying diagnosis.
